official_verified.category: SF Real Property Transfer Tax Tiers (Article 12-C)
official_verified.verified_value: $1M–<$5M: $3.75/$500 (0.75%); $5M–<$10M: $11.25/$500 (2.25% on ENTIRE price — cliff risk if SF exceeds $5M by 2046–2050!); $10M–<$25M: $27.50/$500 (5.50%). Inheritances & transfers to own revocable trust EXEMPT.
official_verified.source_label: SF Assessor-Recorder Transfer Tax Rates & Exemptions

official_verified.category: SF Rent Ordinance & Rent Board Fee (3-Unit Building)
official_verified.verified_value: Pre-June 13, 1979 3-unit buildings are rent-controlled: allowable annual increase = 1.6% (3/1/26–2/28/27; 1.4% prior year), capped at 60% of Bay Area CPI-U; vacancy decontrol applies on voluntary turnover. Rent Board fee = $59/dwelling unit ($177/yr for 3 units; 50% tenant pass-through). Residential lessors exempt from SF Gross Receipts Tax <$5M.
official_verified.source_label: SF Rent Board Current Rates & FY 2026-27 Budget Memo

official_verified.category: SFPUC Water, Wastewater & Stormwater Rates (FY 2026-27 & FY 2027-28)
official_verified.verified_value: Schedule W-1B (Multi-Family): $19.65–$35.53/mo meter charge + $12.03/CCF (first 3 CCF/unit) or $12.91/CCF (FY26-27); Wastewater Schedule A: $6.62/mo + $20.74/CCF at 95% flow factor; Stormwater Schedule D: $19.66–$29.55/mo (FY26-27) jumping to $28.13–$42.29/mo (FY27-28). 10-Yr Plan projects +6.4%/yr water & +10.1%/yr sewer increases!
official_verified.source_label: SFPUC FY 2026-27 & FY 2027-28 Water/Sewer Rate Schedules & 10-Yr Plan
